labelProvenance: AI visual annotations of public footage, authored after contract freeze and before this cohort model inference; not human-, user-supplied or user-approved labels.
coordinateSystem: decoded source unmirrored 1920x1080 pixels, top-left origin, anatomical left/right
jointRegionFormat: [xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax] inclusive axis-aligned plausible visual region; null explicitly unknown
regionScope: shared conservative envelope for every inspected frame in each segment, not a predicted trajectory or exact point ground truth

method.contactSheetRender: 640x360 image tiles; tool display downsized whole sheets; full-resolution arm/shoulder crops checked at listed frames
method.limitation: One AI reviewer, projected joints partly occluded, no calibrated annotation-error guarantee. Shared regions intentionally broad. All region-based guarantees are conditional on these independently chosen visual envelopes; human confirmation absent. Unknown/cropped wrists remain null rather than inferred coordinates.

segments.reason: First crossed pose: left wrist visible with watch; opposite shoulder hidden by arms. No point imputed for hidden shoulder.
Release and arm crossing; motion blur/partial occlusion prevents bounded wrist centres. Unknown, not neutral certification.
Wrists approach or pass the lower crop during downward swing. No offscreen coordinates invented.
Both wrists visibly well below shoulders, including all frames in this interval.
Left wrist partly behind torso; right wrist remains visibly low. Left remains unknown.
Both wrist centres visible and low; broad regions include moving watch wrist.
Wrists again near lower crop/blurred while arms start moving. Do not infer a continuous neutral span across this interval.
Rising arm exchange: both wrist centres remain below own shoulder; broad bounds allow down or transition, never up.
Left wrist bends upward rapidly while right arm extends across chest. Left onset and opposite-down cutoff uncertain.
Bent left wrist high, opposite straight wrist near the down cutoff. Left shoulder partly visible/obscured; deliberately broad region, no exact point claim.
Crossed pose moves upward. Broad shoulder/wrist bounds do not establish continuous opposite-down or a definite left-up onset.
Stable high crossed pose: both wrist regions exclude down relative to own shoulder over all bounded configurations.
Straight wrist settles toward shoulder height; bent left wrist excludes down. Right down/transition uncertainty retained.

uncertainIntervals.reason: Initial crossed pose/release/cropped wrists: incomplete joints and uncertain gates; not certified negative exposure.
